summary: Jamaican-Canadian Pentecostal preacher Kevin O. Smith, a convicted sex offender, built a prosperity-gospel church in Montego Bay, then turned to COVID conspiracies and in 2021 led a ritual killing of congregants.

evidence.note: Birth year given as probably 1982, with some sources suggesting the late 1980s
Family emigrates from Jamaica to Canada in the mid-1990s; he later holds Canadian citizenship
Long segment on Vision International University and its questionable accreditation
Founds his own ministry around the turn of the millennium
2006 sexual assault of an escort and 2007 conviction in Canada
Prosperity gospel history and his escalating donation schemes in Jamaica
COVID lockdowns push him into anti-vaccine and mark-of-the-beast conspiracies
October 2021 gathering at the Ark ends in throat-cutting killings and a police shootout
Dies in a car crash in police custody less than two weeks later

notes: Birth year is uncertain (host says probably 1982; a 36th birthday in April 2018 supports it). main_span starts at the founding of his ministry around 2000. Pathways was an umbrella Pentecostal body he affiliated with; the congregation he led functioned as a cult, so org_type cult is a judgement call. US appears only as background (Azusa Street, Vision International), so it is left out of setting.
